visualCharacteristics: Three label/value groups side by side (Level+Total | Prep+Cook | Yield+Nutrition Info) in small type between 1px #e0e0e0 rules, bold labels, red 'Nutrition Info' toggle opening a popover; groups stack on mobile

contentPattern.rows: One row per item in each group (two rows on recipe pages)
cells: Label: value (e.g. 'Yield: 8 samosas') / 'Nutrition Info' paragraph followed by a list of nutrition facts
contentPattern.structure: Each column is one group; each row adds one item to every group. Write each item as 'Label: value' (the label may be bold). A cell holding a list becomes a toggle button (text from the paragraph before the list) that reveals the list in a popover

usage.description: Recipe summary under the recipe title: level, total/prep/cook times, yield and a Nutrition Info popover.

reuseGuidance: Use once per recipe page, under the title and rating. Keep values short; put the nutrition facts as a bulleted list ('Calories: 327') under a 'Nutrition Info' paragraph in the last cell. Empty cells are skipped.
